required_fixes: The IVC acceptance criterion is contradictory by design: the invariance leg requires perm_p > 0.01 (statistic INVARIANT to within-stratum treatment permutation) while the displacement leg requires displacement > MDD (statistic SENSITIVE to treatment). These two legs are mutually exclusive for any estimator that reads the treatment. The known-good estimator (PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD-VALIDATED) passes displacement (delta=0.203 > MDD=0.0256) but fails invariance (perm_p=0.0016 < 0.01). All known-bad estimators pass invariance but fail displacement (delta≈0 < MDD). No estimator can satisfy both legs simultaneously. This is a design artifact, not a scientific falsification. The invariance leg must be corrected to require sensitivity to treatment permutation (perm_p < 0.01) or the dual-leg structure must be redesigned.

Three of four Codex estimators (PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD-VALIDATED, KB-PRODUCT-COLD-NONCONSTANT, KB-FRONTIER-GOAL-NONCONSTANT) have 'TBD_AT_DESIGN_TIME' sha256 values and were NOT imported by sha256 from Codex artifacts as required by G5-CODEX-SHA256. The codex/ directory is empty. Only KB-PHYSICS-CMI was verified against its hash-pinned artifact. The frozen design requires import by exact sha256; this was not delivered.

The PC-RUNTIME-HEADER-JACCARD-VALIDATED estimator is implemented as a Jaccard similarity of response headers rather than the exact Codex artifact from EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580. The positive control is not the preregistered Codex artifact; its provenance is unverified.

The pre-freeze reachability proof and power calculation (G3, G4) use a normal approximation for the null displacement distribution (rng.normal(E_null_bits, max(E_null_bits * 0.1, 0.01))) rather than the actual matched-null re-draw distribution that the IVC uses. This does not match the frozen procedure in prereg.md Section 9.3-9.4 which specifies matched-null re-draws.

The permutation test for the invariance leg uses only 10 permutations per stratum (line 748: 'for _ in range(10)') rather than the 1000 per stratum specified in prereg.md Section 9.1. This reduces resolution and may affect perm_p estimates.

The matched-null re-draw for the displacement leg uses a single fixed null_assignment (line 579) rather than 1000 independent within-stratum relabels of the TRUE assignment as specified in prereg.md Section 9.2. The null_stats are computed by re-evaluating on this single null_assignment 1000 times, which does not generate independent null draws.

The MDD is computed from a simulated normal distribution at design time (lines 432-442) rather than from the actual matched-null re-draw distribution that will be used at execution time. The frozen MDD (0.025635 bits) is in 'bits' units but the estimator statistics are in heterogeneous units (Jaccard similarity, conditional entropy in bits, cost ratios, success rates, hash fractions). The dimensionless criterion requires MDD in the estimator's own units per estimator, not a single shared MDD in bits.
validity_findings: CONTRADICTORY_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION: The IVC requires BOTH invariance (perm_p > 0.01, statistic insensitive to treatment permutation) AND displacement (displacement > MDD, statistic sensitive to treatment). This is logically impossible for any estimator that reads the treatment. The producer explicitly acknowledges this in validity_notes[0] and validity_notes[13]: 'This is contradictory for any estimator that reads the treatment: invariance fails but displacement passes.' The outcome FALSIFIES is a design artifact, not a scientific result.
